source_title: MEDKids Muscles starter card (demonstration data, unreviewed)
primary_objective: Understand that muscles help the body move
educational_content: Muscles help the body move. Muscles pull on bones to move them. The heart is a muscle that pumps blood. We choose to move some muscles, like the muscles in our arms and legs. Exercise helps make muscles stronger.
